record.question: In what language was the Indian National Anthem (Jana Gana Mana) originally composed?
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Combined 2023 Preliminary Exam Answer Key Paper-I Series 'A'..pdf
record.explanation:
Jana Gana Mana was composed by Rabindranath Tagore in Bengali. PIB identifies the anthem as “Jana Gana Mana (in Bengali Jono Gono Mono)” and notes its first singing in 1911 and later adoption as India’s National Anthem in 1950. The exam asks the original composition language, so the answer is Bengali rather than the language used in common transliteration or performance.

Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/erelcontent.aspx?lang=2&reg=48&relid=38608
